entries.text: run_cmd "python3 -m pip install requests protobuf" || add_warning "Failed to install Python packages"

note: CRITICAL Python-3.6 constraint: these system-python3 installs MUST stay UNPINNED (no ==) so pip resolves a 3.6-compatible requests on Ubuntu 18.04. requests==2.32.4 requires Python 3.8+, so the bump applies ONLY to the two Python-3.11 pin sites, never here.
